summary: David’s sons are named—The successors of Solomon to Jeconiah and beyond are listed.
meta_description: David’s sons are named—The successors of Solomon to Jeconiah and beyond are listed.

footnotes.note5_c: Bath-shua is Bathsheba; and the name Eliam is the same as Ammiel with its syllables transposed.
footnotes.note19_a: According to these verses, Zerubbabel was the grandson of Jeconiah through Pedaiah; elsewhere he is called the son of Shealtiel. Ezra 3:2; 5:2; Hag. 1:1; Matt. 1:12.
